name: r6-01-approval
title: Round 6 @ a7f05901: F9 and F10 are fixed on the real stack
subtitle: approval-mode default. The Harness is SIGKILLed while a channel turn waits for approval; the sender writes again at once.

panels.h: F9: the recovered approval hands the Workspace back
panels.t:
## Bob: write_file c.txt → tool_approval_1780… requested
19:06:27 Harness SIGKILL; follow-up admitted at +66 s
## allow
++ … keeps its durable wait for its approval (held)
++ … was settled without a reply; reply at +84 s
++ runtime sessions not RELEASED: 0
++ managed_workspace_execution_lease holder = NULL
## another thread right after: write_file d.txt
++ approval requested 4 s after the email (mount acquired)
++ allow → d.txt written, reply sent
++ "waits for the Workspace mount" in the Harness log: 0
== round 5 on f7c26828: holder stayed, other threads waited

panels.h: F10: an unanswered approval expires after the restart
panels.t:
## approval timeout 60 s; Bob: write_file e.txt
action tool_approval_097c… created 19:08:36, expires 19:09:36
19:08:36 Harness SIGKILL; nobody answers the approval
++ 19:09:43 the recovery owner expired it and settled the turn;
++   the model's tool result: "The tool call never ran: the
++   approval ended expired after the Harness that asked
++   was interrupted."
++ follow-up answered 70 s after the kill
++ action list empty, runtime sessions RELEASED, lease free
== round 5 / 12:14 review: stayed requested forever

note: Both were re-run on the exact head; a no-crash control (round 5) already showed the normal approval path releasing the lease.

name: r6-02-new-behaviour
title: R8 fixes observable end to end: outbox batch isolation, channel ownership, attachment durability
subtitle: Same stack. Fault injection through the adapter→control-plane proxy; attachments stored in Spring's Session Store (MySQL).

panels.h: One failing receipt no longer aborts the batch
panels.t:
## claims held back so Alice's and Bob's replies batch
19:01:19.212 :claim 200 (both deliveries)
19:01:19.409 :receipt (chin-4dc5…) -- refused (rule)
!! adapter: "receipt … could not be reported …; it
!!   re-drives on the next tick."
19:01:19.696 :receipt (chin-e779…) ++ 200 (same batch)
19:01:22.836 :receipt (chin-4dc5…) ++ 200 (re-driven)
++ 1 reply each, 2 SMTP sends in total, both delivered

panels.h: Re-registering as another actor is refused
panels.t:
## bindings exist; adapter started with --actor other-actor
19:01:59 PUT (register) -- 409 channel_ownership_conflict
++ stored instance still rig-actor; the adapter exits
!! its first log line says "did not answer; the next
!!   poll re-drives it" before it exits (misleading text)

panels.h: Attachment queued behind an interrupted turn
panels.t:
## x1 parked at the model; x2 (report.bin, 30 KB) queued
19:10:11 Harness SIGKILL; x3 sent after the restart
++ x1 settled; the x1+x2 turn ran at 19:11:15 with
++ <attachment name="report.bin" bytes="30000"
++   sha256="2ef47704…" resource="68c77839…"/>
++ qwen_managed_session_resource 68c77839…:
++   managed-channel-attachment, 30000 B inline,
++   state REFERENCED, sha256 matches
++ reply 68 s after the kill

note: Not exercised on the real stack this round: transient envelope-read retry, reply-plan retry, concurrent-registration atomicity and the 50-claim reconcile page (they need store faults or races).
